findings.what: Decision 0078 item 11 and rule L4 say: a language change begun on the result screen is discarded if the visitor left that screen. The ticket is not changed by 'Back' or 'Start over', so only the same-version branch honours this. My probe (copy outside the project, helpers of the tests): result screen, press Kazakh, questionnaire request held, press 'Back', answer arrives with ANOTHER version -> the page goes to the card with the notice, language kk, the stored value is rewritten (the answers are cleared). The same applies to a failed late answer (a connection block appears for a change the visitor abandoned). The outcome is honest (the old answers belong to the old version, nothing stale is shown), so I do not block; but it is the same kind as the step-09 defect (stale reply handled in one branch of a shared function, AP-014) and no test pins it (QP-9j uses the same version only). Design L1 ('another version - as B1') and L4 do not say which rule wins.
findings.fix: ORCH decides, then one of: (a) write in design L4 and 0078 item 11 that a new version wins over a left screen, and add a test of that; or (b) CODE-FIXER: return before newVersion/langFailed when from === 'result' and state.screen !== 'result', plus a test in QP-9j for a new version and for a failed late answer; then gates again.
